- name: Controlla quali servizi e dati esistono

text.tspan: echo "compose=$(test -f compose.yaml && test -f .env.example && echo true || echo false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "csv=$(test -f data/esempi/impianto.csv && echo true || echo false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "backend=$(test -f backend/Dockerfile && echo true || echo false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
